source_quote: This Lab helps prepare students seeking to pass advanced Cisco Certifications. The
answer: COSC 360L Networking Lab, 1(0,2): prepares for Cisco certifications; network equipment and protocols, building a simple Ethernet network with routers and switches, router CLI configuration and verification, and network troubleshooting.

source_quote: requisite: COSC 360 or CCEE 354. Equivalent to CCEE 354L.
answer: COSC 360L Networking Lab has co-requisite COSC 360 or CCEE 354 and is equivalent to CCEE 354L.

source_quote: Each student must complete 8 weeks of practical training in a field related to their
answer: COSC 399 Co-op Training Experience, 1(1,0): 8 weeks of practical training, usually in the summer of the third year, with a formal report, poster and presentation. Prerequisite: ENGL 217; Senior Standing.

source_quote: This course covers theoretical principles embodied in automata and grammars. Topics
answer: COSC 421 Theory of Computation, 3(3,0): automata and grammars - DFA, NFA, e-NFA, minimization, Moore and Mealy machines, regular expressions and languages, pumping lemma, context-free grammars, pushdown automata and Turing machines.

source_quote: Students learn the concepts of operating systems theory and their implementations.
answer: COSC 451 Operating Systems, 3(3,0): OS structures, processes and threads, synchronization, deadlocks, security, inter-process communication, memory management and I/O, with a UNIX case study.

source_quote: Equivalent to CCEE 513.
answer: COSC 451 Operating Systems is equivalent to CCEE 513.

source_quote: This is a yearlong graduation project focused on individual problems and research.
answer: COSC 490 Summative Learning Experience, 3(3,0): described as a yearlong graduation project on individual problems and research in the student's emphasis area. Prerequisite: ENGL 217.
review_note: p.146 describes COSC 490 as yearlong and focused on individual problems, while p.142 says students work preferably in groups and the study plan lists it in one semester.

source_quote: This course provides students with the skills to manage their business projects using
answer: BMGT 300 Project Management, 3(3,0): leading, organizing, scheduling and controlling project tasks, project selection, statement of work, work breakdown structure, PERT/CPM scheduling and budgeting. Prerequisite: Junior Standing.

source_quote: This course introduces the basic principles, theories, and marketing practices in our
answer: BMKA 200 Introduction to Marketing, 3(3,0): marketing principles, creating and capturing customer value, the marketing mix and customer relationships, with real-life case studies. Co-requisite: ENGL 210.

source_quote: This course addresses the design of embedded real-time systems, models of
answer: CCEE 426 Design of Embedded Systems, 3(3,0): embedded real-time system design, models of computation, validation, synthesis, finite-state machines, Petri nets, scheduling and system-level simulation.

source_quote: and interface-based design. Prerequisite: CCEE 221. Equivalent to COSC 356.
answer: CCEE 426 Design of Embedded Systems requires CCEE 221 and is equivalent to COSC 356.
review_note: CS elective table (p.141) lists the prerequisite as COSC 351 (the CS equivalent of CCEE 221).

source_quote: This course builds on the web programming course and prepares students to become
answer: COSC 434 Advanced Web Programming, 3(3,0): full-stack development - back-end programs, database connection, regular expressions, asynchronous requests, JSON, and web services.

source_quote: Prerequisites: COSC 231 and COSC 333. Equivalent to CCEE 514.
answer: COSC 434 Advanced Web Programming requires COSC 231 and COSC 333 and is equivalent to CCEE 514.

source_quote: This course examines the principles of mobile application design, development, and
answer: COSC 435 Mobile Application Development, 3(2,2): mobile app design, development and testing, memory management, UI design, input methods, data handling and networking, with a deployed professional-quality project.

source_quote: Prerequisite: COSC 214, Equivalent to CCEE 511
answer: COSC 435 Mobile Application Development requires COSC 214 and is equivalent to CCEE 511.

source_quote: This course provides an overview of software technologies for game development. It
answer: COSC 436 Game Programming, 3(2,2): software technologies for game development, game design concepts and practical game creation.

source_quote: game creation. Prerequisites: COSC 214; Senior standing.
answer: The prerequisites for COSC 436 Game Programming are COSC 214 and senior standing.

source_quote: will introduce students to software testing, its importance, goals,
answer: COSC 438 Introduction to Software Testing, 3(3,0): testing life cycle, standards, manual vs automated testing, black-box vs white-box methods, testing levels, documentation and automated testing tools.

source_quote: automated testing tools. Prerequisite: COSC 341
answer: The prerequisite for COSC 438 Introduction to Software Testing is COSC 341.

answer: COSC 460L Networking Lab 2, 1(0,2): CCNA 1 preparation - network equipment and protocols, building Ethernet networks, router CLI configuration and hands-on troubleshooting. Co-requisite COSC 360L or CCEE 354L; equivalent to CCEE 554L.

source_quote: This course prepares students to act as System and Network Administrators by
answer: COSC 461 Advanced Networking, 3(3,0): system and network administration with Active Directory Domain Services, domain controllers and automated administration of users, groups and computers.

source_quote: computers. Prerequisite: COSC 360 or CCEE 354.
answer: The prerequisite for COSC 461 Advanced Networking is COSC 360 or CCEE 354.

source_quote: This Lab helps prepare students seeking to pass the Cisco Routing and Switching
answer: COSC 461L Networking Lab 3, 1(0,2): CCNA 2 preparation - router and switch architecture and configuration, static and dynamic routing, ACLs, VLANs, DHCP for IPv4/IPv6 and NAT.

source_quote: Pre-requisite: COSC 460L or CCEE 554L. Equivalent to CCEE 555L.
answer: COSC 461L Networking Lab 3 requires COSC 460L or CCEE 554L and is equivalent to CCEE 555L.

source_quote: This lab helps prepare students seeking to pass the Cisco Routing and Switching
answer: COSC 462L Networking Lab 4, 1(0,2): CCNA 3 preparation - advanced router/switch configuration, enhanced switching, first-hop redundancy, wireless, and Cisco IOS licensing. Co-requisite COSC 461L or CCEE 555L; equivalent to CCEE 556L.

source_quote: This hands-on, career-oriented course focuses on practical topics to prepare students
answer: COSC 463 Cybersecurity Operations, 3(3,0): hands-on cybersecurity skills preparing for the Cisco Cybersecurity Operations Associate certification. Prerequisite: COSC 360 (or CCEE 354).

source_quote: This course introduces students to the basic knowledge representation and learning
answer: COSC 480 Machine Learning and Data Mining, 3(3,0): knowledge representation, learning techniques, the data mining process, classification, prediction and clustering, and building intelligent applications.

source_quote: and clustering. Prerequisites: COSC 214 and MATH 351 or BADM 250. Equivalent to
answer: COSC 480 Machine Learning and Data Mining requires COSC 214 and MATH 351 or BADM 250; it is equivalent to CCEE 564.

source_quote: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of knowledge representation and
answer: COSC 481 Artificial Intelligence, 3(3,0): knowledge representation and learning in AI, intelligent agents, informed and uninformed search, adversarial search, and Python libraries.

source_quote: The Python language libraries will also be introduced. Prerequisite: COSC 214.
answer: COSC 481 Artificial Intelligence requires COSC 214 and is equivalent to CCEE 562.

answer: COSC 482 Data Science and Web Scraping, 3(3,0): data science processes with web scraping in Python, analyzing webpage HTML, extracting information and generating dashboards.

answer: The co-requisites for COSC 482 Data Science and Web Scraping are COSC 333 (or CCEE 411) and MATH 351 (or BADM 250).

source_quote: Prerequisites: Senior Standing and a CGPA of 80 and above.
answer: COSC 496 Independent Study I and COSC 497 Independent Study II (3 credits each) let students pursue research not available in regular courses; both require senior standing and a CGPA of 80 or above.

source_quote: COSC 498 Special Topics in Computer Science 1-3 credits
answer: COSC 498 Special Topics in Computer Science carries 1-3 credits, covers current trends via seminars, readings or projects, and requires senior standing.
review_note: Description gives 1-3 credits; CS elective table (p.141) lists 3 credits.
